systems.system: Système d'information policière d'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: Centre de documentation de sécurité publique (CDSP), Benin's DACORE, under the Ministry of Justice and Legislation; national committee (WANACO) set up January 2020 and chaired by the director general of the Police républicaine
systems.tiers: described by the justice minister as a tool for collecting, analysing and exchanging information between national law-enforcement services; the CDSP extends it each year into law-enforcement services and trains operators of digital terminals and validators; standard procedures validated November 2023 and being disseminated in the departments since October 2024; no number of sites and no station-level entry stated

systems.system: plateforme régionale d'échange d'informations du SIPAO
accès direct du SIPAO-BÉNIN au système d'information d'INTERPOL
systems.owner: B.C.N./Bénin and SIPAO-Bénin, by agreement signed September 2023

systems.system: Système automatisé de reconnaissance d'empreintes digitales (AFIS)
systems.owner: supplied by Thales under INTERPOL supervision; launched in Benin in May 2024 at a ceremony chaired by the justice minister
systems.tiers: pilot country with Gambia and Togo; active deployment from October 2024, to be operational by end 2024; ministerial circular obliges all criminal-justice actors to take prints of suspects and accused

note: No fact: the minister's editorial gives SIPAO's owner (CDSP under the justice ministry), decree 2024-877 of 11 April 2024 on processing police, judicial and prison information, EU funding and yearly extension into law-enforcement services, but does not say that stations enter their reports or cases in it, which the typology requires before the system is classed record. The parent should weigh it with documents 23 and 25. The Togo, Chad and other countries' passages are not Benin's.
